g.text: Memory is the biggest line in every designer's bill

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: what each designer's component bill is actually made of, cumulated over the whole window. The published

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: views stack cost either by component or by designer; this crosses the two, which is the only way to see that the four

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280
font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, AI Chip Components (CC-BY) — cumulative_by_designer.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-chip-components

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI Chip Components methodology; every figure is a Monte Carlo median over 10,000 draws

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Cumulative through Q4 2025, read from Epoch's cumulative file. HBM is the largest single line for every designer, ranging from 46% of

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Google's bill to 66% of AMD's - memory, not the logic die, is what an AI accelerator mostly costs to build. Bars are ordered by total

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: spend, printed at the right. Auxiliary is Epoch's own catch-all for the remaining package content and carries no wafer or share

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: counterpart in the source. These are component costs, not chip prices or revenue: margin, board, system assembly, networking and

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: everything above the package are outside the dataset entirely.
